_comment: ReserveChain.io deploy config (TESTNET ONLY). See contracts/README.md#configuration. Keys starting with '_' are comments and ignored. null = unset. 'deployer' resolves to the deployer address.
_safeMultisig: Set to the Safe address that will accept DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (two-step, after adminTransferDelaySeconds). null keeps the deployer as admin.

compliance._blockedJurisdictions: EU/EEA ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes per SPEC.md waitlist rules. ReserveChain does not currently intend to offer tokens to residents of, or persons located in, the EU/EEA.

reserveGuard._maxAttestationAgeSeconds: Staleness window. null = UNSET => minting blocked while the guard is enabled.

tokens._comment: Name/symbol are TESTNET PLACEHOLDERS pending final approval. All tokenomics fields are null (unset).
tokens.name: ReserveChain Copper Powder (TESTNET)
tokens._mintingEnabled: Static-cap-mode switch. Minting succeeds only if (a) the reserve guard is enabled and permits it, OR (b) supplyCap is non-null/non-zero AND mintingEnabled is true. Default false (fail-closed).
